EN.title: Hello! I am Eleaz
EN.sm-pseudo: 9 years of passion in Tech, People and Progress
EN.p-exp-current: In early 2026, I joined Singapore Management University (SMU) as a Senior Software Engineer, crafting data-driven solutions and intelligent applications, with AI-assisted engineering at the heart of how I build.
EN.p-exp-latest: Previously Team Lead at MIMS PTE. LTD., where I managed a team of 10 software engineers and delivered scalable solutions using the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including C#, .NET, Azure, and Power Platform.
EN.p-exp-previous: Before that, I served as a Software Engineer at Genpact Headstrong, an IT consulting firm, contributing to critical projects ranging from ASP.NET MVC hosted on IIS to modernizing applications with .NET Core in AWS environments.
EN.p-contact: Feel free to get in touch.
EN.p-footer: This website is built in basic HTML + Pico CSS, hosted in GitHub Pages.
